turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's essay.
I have 140 students. I don't have time to be cross-examined by every parent with a law degree.
Then answer one question. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
You don't get to talk to me like I'm on the stand.
Then don't make me ask three times. Was Owen spoken to before the zero went in, or not?
